description: The viral 8D audio effect: your track circles around your head with a rotating stereo-pan LFO. Play it and download it.

faqs.a: An LFO (low-frequency oscillator) continuously sweeps the stereo pan position in a circle, so the sound appears to orbit around you — best with headphones.
Yes — use headphones or earphones; the effect is a stereo illusion.
Yes — both the live preview and the download use the same rotating-pan graph, rendered in your browser.

title: 8D Audio Panner
